photography.claim: A tactile vessel-and-ingredient still life sits low in frame, photographed frontally with material detail and restrained depth rather than as a finished plated-dish hero.
Soft directional light reveals ceramic texture, ingredient surfaces and grounded shadows without high-gloss advertising contrast.

evidence_pointer.region: vessel, lid, ingredients and ground plane

graphic_design.claim: The large calligraphic title is an asymmetric spatial field of unequal glyph size and position; a vertical side label and restrained bilingual type counterbalance it.

evidence_pointer.region: upper title field and right-side rail

graphic_design.uncertainty: Calligraphic appearance may be surface-bound; asymmetric title-field behavior is the stronger candidate mechanism.

graphic_design.claim: Warm off-white negative space separates the title field, still life and lower information rhythm while maintaining optical tension rather than behaving as unused background.

evidence_pointer.region: full composition between title, vessel and metadata

graphic_design.claim: A four-part lower label rhythm plus a quiet paragraph creates secondary and tertiary editorial reads beneath the main image/title relationship.
graphic_design.uncertainty: The exact count of four is reference-specific; a multi-tier quiet information rhythm is the candidate signature.

integration.claim: Title strokes, vessel silhouette, ingredient uprights, side rail and lower metadata share a balanced vertical-horizontal geometry, so text and still life jointly construct the page.
Warm paper and olive-black lettering are visible signals but are insufficient without the asymmetric editorial geometry and still-life/information roles.
integration.uncertainty: Requires palette and content transfer tests to distinguish structure from surface styling.

v2_migration.semantic_change: V3 adds exact evidence pointers and keeps photographed subject role explicitly content-bound where appropriate.
Evidence remains analysis, not an automatically executable style grammar.
Integration claims remain hypotheses until human and transfer review.
